caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) against the number of sub-dimensions in a model, with a focus on comparing performance based on sub-dimensions. The x-axis is labeled "Numbers of Sub-Dims" with a linear scale except for 1632, and the values range from 1632 to 256 with ticks at 1632, 64, 128, and 256. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 9.5 to 12.5 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. There are two lines on the plot. The first line, representing the "Transformer," is red with a dashed style, presenting a constant value at a perplexity level of 11.6 across all sub-dimensions. The second line, labeled "MoHD," is blue with square markers and a solid line style. It shows values starting at approximately 10.4 at 1632 sub-dimensions, increasing slightly to around 10.6 at 256 sub-dimensions, with a noticeable peak around 10.7 at 128 sub-dimensions. A legend is placed at the bottom left corner of the plot.
